mapper.select: SELECT U."userNo", U."userName", UI."userBirth", '접속중' AS "status", -- 거리를 계산하되 필터링은 하지 않음 (단위: KM) ROUND( SDO_GEOM.SDO_DISTANCE( YOUR_LOC."LOCATION", (SELECT "LOCATION" FROM "USER_LOCATIONS" WHERE "USERNO" = #{userNo}), 0.005, 'unit=KM' ), 1 ) AS "distance", ( SELECT LISTAGG(IMG."imageUrl", ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY IMG."imageProfile" DESC, IMG."imageNo") FROM "userImage" IMG WHERE IMG."userNo" = U."userNo" ) AS "images" FROM "users" U JOIN "userInfo" UI ON U."userNo" = UI."userNo" JOIN "USER_LOCATIONS" YOUR_LOC ON U."userNo" = YOUR_LOC."USERNO" WHERE U."userNo" != #{userNo} ORDER BY "distance" ASC
